root_cause_criterion.obligation: After freeing obj via sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) in the while-loop body at line 58, obj must be reallocated before subsequent use
root_cause_criterion.fix_action: obj = calloc(1, sizeof *obj) added after sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) in the while-loop body

nodes.description: At the post-loop sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) call at line 60, obj is passed as argument. In the vulnerable version, obj is a dangling pointer causing heap-use-after-free when obj->type is read at pkcs15.c:1882.
decode_entries[i]() returns SC_SUCCESS, causing the while-loop body containing the free to execute.

edges.description: The same obj pointer used in the decode call is passed to sc_pkcs15_free_object in the loop body.
The obj pointer value from the realloc check point propagates to the post-loop free call.
